prompts.square:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: newly composed full-bleed cinematic advertising art plate for the attached Pixelkovia family home mystery campaign. NO TEXT; precise editable Slovak typography will be added separately.
Input image 1 is the approved source art: preserve this family's warm believable faces, children's clothing, blue cloud-headed suited character, orange shield character and the atmosphere. Input image 2 is the existing finished advertisement: creative direction and campaign continuity only, not a layout to pad, letterbox or crop.
Primary request: Recompose and regenerate the entire room scene for the specified canvas, with realistic newly rendered environment all the way to every edge. It must look intentionally photographed in this aspect ratio, not like the portrait image placed inside a different canvas. Keep the recognizable ordinary living room at blue hour: blue sofa and knit throw, wooden coffee table, amber fabric-shaded standing lamp, bookshelf, leafy houseplants, window to evening city. Natural smiling light-brown-haired boy in blue hoodie and blonde ponytail girl in cream T-shirt aged 8–11 leaning over ONE shared smartphone with simple generic navy-blue tile puzzle, adult arm pointing from left. Paper clue fragments and lime pencil on table. Delight, curiosity and teamwork; no posed looks at camera.
Integrate the original tiny orange ornate shield protector with cream smiling face, teal tie and glowing cyan keyhole near the left table edge, and original tiny BLUE CLOUD-HEADED screen-face hero in black suit, white shirt and teal tie, orange clipboard, seated at the near-right edge with dangling boots. Preserve their approved original soft painted pixel texture and identities, matched contact shadows and amber/cyan light. They are imagined helpers in an illustrated advertisement, not plastic dolls. A restrained trail of luminous golden pixel motes connects the paper and phone.
No third character in the background plate: the yellow square character from reference 2 will be placed as a separate editable element later. NO captions, typography, text, names, logos, buttons, decorative frames, watermarks, QR codes, answers or complete worksheets. Paper shows only cropped generic abstract lines obscured by hands. Preserve natural hands and anatomy; one phone only. No extra fingers, merged limbs, collage, border, solid-colored bars, blank canvas extensions, screen screenshots, or giant magical digital table. Premium editorial realism for people and interior, original painted pixel texture for the two mascots, refined navy/cream/amber/cyan palette. Darker text areas must still be visibly continuous real room surfaces, never featureless navy panels.
Output: EXACT SQUARE 1:1 composition, preferably 1536×1536 pixels.
Native square art direction: tighter, wider camera than the source portrait, with the children's faces and shared phone forming a compact triangle in the middle/lower frame. Upper-left 60% width by first 35% height is quiet shaded midnight-blue living-room wall and soft window detail for a 3-line headline. Lamp/bookcase glow in upper-right. Children's heads occupy approximately x=32–85%, y=39–65%; phone x=52–68%, y=62–78%; shield x=8–25%, y=68–81%; blue cloud hero x=77–93%, y=66–85%. Leave a continuous naturally darkened tabletop foreground lower 16% for facts/CTA, with subtle wood/rug detail extending to bottom edge. Full-scene balance for a square social ad, strong readable family action, no excessive vacant wall. Make phone and both mascots entirely visible, no cropped mascot heads.
